ayah_23_1_2.text: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۝ الَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي صَلَاتِهِمْ خَاشِعُونَ
ayah_23_1_2.translation: Successful indeed are the believers, those who are humble in their prayer.

dua_14_40.text: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي
dua_14_40.translation: My Lord, make me one who establishes prayer, and from my descendants.
dua_14_40.note: The verse continues after ذُرِّيَّتِي (ربنا وتقبل دعاء). The script and the VO stop here, and so does the poster. Do not add a verse-end marker.
